d:
Every load of dirt holds a possibility, but the real test comes when the miners clean out their sluice boxes and see how much gold they've recovered. Across these Gold Rush adventures, crews work through the cleanup process, hoping their hard work has paid off. Even after hours of digging and washing, the final haul can bring surprises, disappointments or a much-needed boost.
Will the gold in the boxes make all the effort worthwhile?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 3, Episodes 7, 2, 3, 15, 6, 14, 9 and 5, on Discovery Channel India.
